---
name: pskill
description: "Resume, inspect, pause, or cancel a pskill run (a programmatic skill run). Use when the user mentions an unfinished skill run, or asks which runs exist."
---
<!-- Generated by pskill. Do not edit. Run: uv run .pskill/pskill.py sync -->
Commands of the pskill runner:
- List the unfinished runs, with each run's key: `uv run .pskill/pskill.py runs --open`
- Show the current block of a run again: `uv run .pskill/pskill.py current <run-id> --key <key>`
- Resume a paused run: `uv run .pskill/pskill.py resume <run-id> --key <key>`
- Wait on background work, in the background (Claude Code only): `uv run .pskill/pskill.py wait <run-id> --reason "<what>"`
- Run a background script, in the background (Claude Code only): `uv run .pskill/pskill.py run-script <run-id>`
- Pause a run: `uv run .pskill/pskill.py pause <run-id> --key <key>`
- Stop a run for good: `uv run .pskill/pskill.py cancel <run-id>`
- Open the run viewer: `uv run .pskill/pskill.py view`

A worktree run (`start --worktree`) lives in its own worktree folder, which `runs` names: run the other commands from that folder.
